hand_memory_route.hold_on_failed_comparison: H84 runs hand goals from memory, so this mechanism steers production; by the operator's decision of 2026-09-25 9:09 AM PDT (docs/gain_of_function_v3/WORKLOG.md) a round that fails its declared comparison keeps the saved pause for review instead of resuming training. A round that ends without a valid result is a failed attempt and follows the retry rules; it did not measure the mechanism. first_step stays out of reach so that a scheduler without this hold (every one started before this change) never runs the task; a scheduler with it starts the task at first_step_under_hold.
